name: contention
title: The same work, on one word or on many
summary: Every worker makes the same number of increments, on one shared atomic counter, on an atomic counter of its own on its own cache line, or on a plain counter of its own. The page runs one worker, then two, then more, and draws the rate.

controls.name: layout
controls.label: Counters
controls.hint: compare runs all three. one shared: every worker on one atomic counter. one each: an atomic counter per worker, a line apart. one each, plain: a plain counter per worker, a line apart.

results.name: observed
results.label: Observed
results.what: every counter added up, for the largest worker count

results.name: rate
results.label: Increments per millisecond
results.what: for each worker count, the total increments divided by the wall time

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: for the largest worker count, from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing
